tools.name: llms-txt_structure-validate
tools.description: Check caller-supplied llms.txt text or structured JSON for one H1, a summary blockquote, H2 sections, and well-formed list links. URLs are not fetched. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/llms-txt/structure-validate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: llms-txt_link-quality-check
tools.description: Review link titles and descriptions in caller-supplied llms.txt content for generic labels and missing descriptions. Links are not opened. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/llms-txt/link-quality-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: llms-txt_context-budget-analyze
tools.description: Measure caller-supplied llms.txt size, repeated lines, and repeated link paths. The token figure is characters divided by four, not a model tokenizer. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/llms-txt/context-budget-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: llms-txt_coverage-analyze
tools.description: Compare llms.txt link paths with a caller-supplied page list and report pages that have no matching link. tools.name: llms-txt_navigation-analyze
tools.description: Find repeated link titles that point at different paths and generic section names in caller-supplied llms.txt content. No page is fetched. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/llms-txt/navigation-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: llms-txt_contradiction-detect
tools.description: Compare caller-supplied llms.txt text with caller-supplied documents for conflicting account, API key, price, and HTTP method statements. tools.name: llms-txt_version-consistency
tools.description: Compare caller-supplied llms.txt versions for /api/vN/ majors, summary semantic versions, updated dates, and link titles whose paths differ. Neither version is fetched. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/llms-txt/version-consistency. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "llms-txt" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: llms-txt_structure-validate, llms-txt_link-quality-check, llms-txt_coverage-analyze · Private data: llms-txt_context-budget-analyze, llms-txt_contradiction-detect · Public sink: llms-txt_structure-validate, llms-txt_link-quality-check, llms-txt_context-budget-analyze, llms-txt_coverage-analyze, llms-txt_navigation-analyze, llms-txt_contradiction-detect, llms-txt_instruction-risk-scan, llms-txt_version-consistency · Destructive: llms-txt_structure-validate, llms-txt_link-quality-check, llms-txt_context-budget-analyze, llms-txt_coverage-analyze, llms-txt_navigation-analyze, llms-txt_contradiction-detect, llms-txt_instruction-risk-scan, llms-txt_version-consistency.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
